text: I'd like to express my opinion. Today, I took my younger brother to have his tattoo removed at a clinic. I'm extremely dissatisfied with the staff's answer. The tattoo removal price is 2,000 baht per session. I asked on their Facebook page and they said they were offering a special price of 4,500 baht for 3 sessions. If you pay per session, it's 2,000 baht. When I got there and asked the staff, they said that if the price is 4,500 baht, you can only use one mode. I'm really confused. If you pay 2,000 baht in cash per session, you can get 3 modes. Wouldn't it be better to pay 2,000 baht? I'm very disappointed. I really intended to buy a course for my younger brother (but the female staff spoke nicely).
